title.en: comedy open mic at the kulturcafé henriette.
title.de: comedy open mic im kulturcafé henriette.

line.en: eight comedians with seven minutes each, hosted by sebastian haring. free entry, but the listing asks you to reserve. the cafe is in brigittenau, staudingergasse 10.
line.de: acht comedians mit je sieben minuten, moderiert von sebastian haring. eintritt frei, laut ankündigung bitte reservieren. das café liegt in der brigittenau, staudingergasse 10.
line.tr: sebastian haring'in sunduğu, her biri yedi dakikalık sekiz komedyen. giriş ücretsiz, ilanda istendiği gibi yer ayırtmak iyi olur. kafe brigittenau'da, staudingergasse 10'da.

sparks.why: Feucht & Fröhlich comedy open mic, 26.11.2026 from 20:00 to 23:00, free with reservation, at Kulturcafé Henriette, per the City of Vienna event listing (wien.gv.at/veranstaltungen/feucht-und-froehlich-comedy-open-mic-3).
